name: Kyuuka no Otoshiana
source:
The protagonist suddenly received a message from her boyfriend Aida Takumi- whom she had been unable to get in contact with since spring of this year- to "meet me in Classroom 901".

However, after dashing to that classroom, the person waiting for her there wasn't Aida, but her underclassman Takazaki Yuki.

He gives the protagonist a mysterious smile as she searches for any sign of Aida's presence...

[Translation of [URL=http://2015kara.wixsite.com/kiwaraku/-------]official website story summary[/URL].]
translation:
主角突然收到从今年春天起就一直联系不上的男友相田拓海发来的“901教室见”的消息。

然而，冲到那间教室后，在那里等她的人不是相田，而是她的学弟高崎由希。

当主角寻找阿伊达存在的迹象时，他给了她一个神秘的微笑……

【[URL=http://2015kara.wixsite.com/kiwaraku/-------]官网故事摘要翻译[/URL]。】
